title: Keto Fajita Butter
description: A silky and indulgent keto-friendly dish featuring a blend of fajita seasoning with butter for a rich, creamy texture.
instructions: Melt the butter in a small saucepan over low heat.
Add the fajita seasoning blend and stir until well combined with the melted butter, creating a silky mixture.
Squeeze the juice from one lime into the mixture and stir again to combine flavors.
Serve immediately over your favorite keto-friendly tortilla or as a dip for veggies.
